comments.text:
Pragmata is easily my favorite game from this console generation. Great story and characters while also not being too short, nor too long (game length) while still having a lot of extra content for those who want more from the game (challenges/trials, red key rooms and new game+)

Capcom has been on a tear. I just started Monster Hunter Stories 3 then onto RE: Requiem. After that, I’ll probably start a new game+ on Pragmata

My Switch 2 is gonna be begging for a day off 😂
